proposed_value: minimal promoter (K562 cell line, ExP STARR-seq assay)
rationale:
- The study uses ExP STARR-seq in K562 cells, which typically employs a minimal promoter to measure enhancer activity without confounding effects from strong endogenous promoters.
- The paper describes intrinsic promoter activity as a fit parameter in a multiplicative model, implying a standardized, minimal promoter context to isolate enhancer-promoter compatibility.
- The assay design (STARR-seq) inherently relies on a minimal promoter to assess enhancer function, as confirmed by the use of a control plasmid with random genomic sequences (Methods, Extended Data Fig. 2f,g).
calculation: inferred from assay design and model description
